children: IndusInd Bank has broadened its partnership with HYROX India to cover Ahmedabad, Bengaluru and Noida, following its initial association with HYROX Mumbai earlier in 2026. The expanded deal positions the private lender as a banking partner across the fitness racing series’ multi-city India calendar this season.

Under the arrangement, IndusInd Bank customers will receive cashback offers and race-day benefits including priority check-in, dedicated access lanes and curated on-ground experiences at HYROX events.

HYROX is a standardised fitness race format in which participants complete eight rounds of a 1-km run followed by a functional workout station. Founded in Germany in 2017, the series now operates across more than 30 countries and expects over 1.5 million participants across 123 events globally this season.

title: IndusInd Bank expands HYROX India tie-up to Ahmedabad, Bengaluru and Noida
